# intellumia

> An AI-native services company. We learn how a business really works, build AI with its team one lever at a time, measure it, and hand it over to own.

- [intellumia](https://intellumia.com/): An AI-native services company. We learn how your business really works, build AI with your team on one lever at a time, measure it, and hand it over to own.
- [How it works](https://intellumia.com/how-it-works/): Find, prove, hand over: First Look, Embed, Run and improve, Hand over. One lever and one number at a time, built with your team and owned by you.
- [Where AI works today](https://intellumia.com/where-ai-works-today/): What is working, what is coming and where judgement still decides, in real estate, manufacturing, healthcare and law. Market stories credited to their sources.
- [Our point of view](https://intellumia.com/point-of-view/): Intelligence is now cheap; judgement is not. Why what runs a business was never written down, and why it should stay yours. With sources.
- [The intellumia Sales Engine for real estate developers](https://intellumia.com/sales-engine/): Find and win buyers with an engine you own: every enquiry answered, every site visit followed up, consent first. A working prototype with five founding places.
- [The Lab](https://intellumia.com/lab/): What intellumia is building and how far it has got: seven pieces, each with its true status, from prototype to thesis.
- [Book 30 minutes with Sundeep Kumar](https://intellumia.com/connect/): Bring one lever in your business and leave with a view. Book thirty minutes with Sundeep Kumar, Founder and CEO of intellumia.
- [Privacy notice](https://intellumia.com/privacy/): How intellumia handles personal data under India’s DPDP Act 2023 and Singapore’s PDPA 2012. This website sets no cookies and collects nothing about you.
